_comment: LBNL FDD Chiller-Plant point -> CAMBER Role mapping. The plant has three chillers (_1/_2/_3) and three cooling towers; chiller 1 and tower 1 are the analysed units (the sensor-bias and tower-fouling faults are imposed on unit 1). Maps ONLY the plant-level points the runnable detectors need: chiller kW/ton (power + CHW loop) for chiller_efficiency, and the cooling-tower supply temp + wet-bulb for cooling_tower_approach. The dataset carries NO refrigerant-side points (evaporator/condenser approach, subcooling, superheat), so the refrigerant-side chiller-drift detectors stay synthetic-only -- see docs/VALIDATION.md. Dataset: LBNL Fault Detection and Diagnostics Datasets (CC-BY).
